y-m-63-10.title: Kana tikafambisa k, equation ichava nemaroots mangani?
y-m-63-10.topic: Nhamba yemareal roots akasiyana eequation (uchishandisa malocal extrema ecubic function)
y-m-63-10.goal: Sezvo tebhura neruzivo rwekukwira nekudzika kwecubic function zvichipiwa nhanho nenhanho, gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwenhamba yemareal roots akasiyana e f(x)=k, uye unyore nhamba zvichienderana nechiyero che k, kusanganisira kukosha kwemiganhu.
y-m-63-10.material:
Kune function f(x)=x³−6x²+9x nenhamba chaiyo k, wana nhamba yemareal roots akasiyana eequation f(x)=k (nhamba chaiyo x dzakasiyana dzinoita equation) zvichienderana nekukosha kwe k. (Verenga 'x cubed minus 6 x squared plus 9x'.) Pazasi pane f(x) pa x dzemaintegers.
x | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
f(x) | 0 | 4 | 2 | 0 | 4
y-m-63-10.thinking.0: Fungidzira nzvimbo dzemaroots netebhura neruzivo rwekukwira nekudzika
y-m-63-10.thinking.1: Wedzera chiyero chekutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera
y-m-63-10.thinking.2: Tsanangura mhedziso ine mamiriro (nechiyero che k) kusvika kumiganhu
y-m-63-10.prereq.2: Hunhu hwekuti function continuous haisvetuki kukosha, uye kuti cubic equation ine mareal roots akasiyana 3 pakanyanya
y-m-63-10.s.s1.prompt: Sezvo k ichichinja, data rinoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kwako nezvenhamba yemareal roots akasiyana.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.hint.0: Mutebhura, batanidza uye uwane machiyero umo kukosha kwe f(x) kunobva pasi pe k kuenda pamusoro pe k, uye kubva pamusoro kuenda pasi.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchishandisa ruzivo rwekukwira nekudzika, ongorora chiyero nechiyero kana chiyero chinokwirirwa nekudzikiswa ne f muchiyero chega chega chichipfuura ne k.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Fungidzira equation f(x)=2 kune k=2. Mutebhura, f(2)=2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti f(x)=2 ine mareal roots akasiyana mangani? (f icontinuous cubic function uye ine mareal roots akasiyana 3 pakanyanya.)
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Sezvo f(0)=0<2<f(1)=4, pane root pakati pe0 ne1; sezvo f(2)=2, pane root pa x=2; uye sezvo f(3)=0<2<f(4)=4, pane root pakati pe3 ne4. Pane mareal roots akasiyana 3 pakanyanya, saka pane 3 chaiyo (chaizvo 2−√3, 2, 2+√3).
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakamira mushure mekutarisa root imwe chete x=2 yakawanikwa mutebhura. Tarisa kana pane machiyero mamwe umo kukosha kwetebhura kunobva pasi pe2 kuenda pamusoro pe2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakawana machiyero ose etebhura umo kukosha kwe f(x) kunoyambuka 2 ndokuverenga nzvimbo dzemaroots.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakangowedzera imwe kuroot yakaongororwa mutebhura. Ongorora kana wakawana machiyero ose umo kukosha kunopfuura nepa2.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaona sekusingagoneki kutaura chinhu nezve x isiri mutebhura. Unogona kushandisa hunhu hwekuti kana function continuous ichiyambuka kukosha, pane root pakati.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Fungidzira f(x)=5 kune k=5. Zvose f(x) mutebhura i4 kana pasi. Kana tafarira tebhura, f(5)=20 ne f(−1)=−16. Zvakare f′(x)=3(x−1)(x−3), saka f inokwira kune x<1, inodzika kune 1<x<3, uye inokwira kune x>3.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: f(x)=5 ine mareal roots akasiyana mangani?
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Kune x<1, f inokwira asi inongosvika pa f(1)=4 uye haisvike pa5; kune 1<x<3 inodzika kubva pa4 kuenda ku0; uye kune x>3 inokwira kubva pa0, uye sezvo f(4)=4<5<f(5)=20, inopfuura 5 kamwe pakati pe4 ne5. Pane real root 1 yakasiyana.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uku kufunga kwakatonga nekutarisa kukosha mukati mechiyero chetebhura chete. Tarisa kuti f inochinja sei kunze kwetebhura.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku kufunga kwakatora nhamba ye k=2 sezvayakaita. Kana k ichichinja, nzvimbo umo mutsetse wakachinjika unosangana negirafu inochinjawo.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kufunga kwakatora nhamba yenyaya yekubata papoinzi yelocal extremum. Ongorora kana f(x)=5 ichienzana nekukosha kwakanyanyisa.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaongorora muchiyero chega chega chekukwira nekudzika kana kukosha kwe f kuchiyambuka 5 ndokuverenga nzvimbo dzemaroots.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Local maximum i f(1)=4 uye local minimum i f(3)=0. Fambisa mutsetse wakachinjika y=k kumusoro napasi pagirafu uye uverenge nhamba yemapoinzi umo unosangana negirafu.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Chiyero chipi che k chinopa mareal roots akasiyana 3 chaiyo?
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana k iri pakati pe0 ne4, mutsetse wakachinjika unosangana negirafu pamapoinzi matatu, saka pane mareal roots akasiyana 3. Kana k=0 kana k=4, unobata papoinzi imwe, saka pane mareal roots akasiyana 2 (k=0: 0, 3 / k=4: 1, 4), uye kana k<0 kana k>4, pane 1.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakashaya kuti pa k=0 ne k=4 mapoinzi ekubata anopindirana uye nhamba yemaroots akasiyana inodzika.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakasanganisa ma x-coordinate 1, 3 emapoinzi elocal extremum nekukosha kwakanyanyisa 4, 0.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaverenga kuti mutsetse wakachinjika unofanira kuva pakati pekukosha kwelocal minimum nekwelocal maximum kuti usangane pamapoinzi matatu.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaverenga chiyero umo pane root 1 sechiyero umo pane 3.
y-m-63-10.s.s1.reflect: Kutonga kwe3 pa k=2 kwakachinja kuita 1 pa k=5. Kutonga kwakachinjwa nokuda kweruzivo rutsva, kana nokuti mamiriro (k) akachinja? Kuvimba kwako kwakasiyana sei kana wakatarisa tebhura chete neapo wakaziva ruzivo rwekukwira nekudzika?
y-m-63-10.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti nhamba yemareal roots akasiyana eequation f(x)=k inochinja sei zvichienderana nekukosha kwe k. Sanganisa nhamba pamakosha emiganhu e k.
y-m-63-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kubva panhanho yapfuura, wana uye unyore makosha maviri e k umo nhamba yemaroots inopatsanuka kuita 3, 2, ne1.
y-m-63-10.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora nhamba yechiyero chega chega pamutsara wayo.
y-m-63-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura nemashoko ako kuti nei nhamba isiri 3 pa k=0 ne k=4 (inobata) here?
y-m-63-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora chiyero che k chaizvo, uchisiyanisa ≤ ne < here?
y-m-63-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora nhamba dzenyaya nhatu (3, 2, 1) imwe neimwe yakabatanidzwa nechiyero che k chakakodzera here?
y-m-63-10.s.s2.model.0: Kana 0<k<4 pane mareal roots akasiyana 3, kana k=0 kana k=4 pane 2, uye kana k<0 kana k>4 pane 1.
y-m-63-10.s.s2.model.1: Fungidzira senhamba yemapoinzi ekusangana kwegirafu y=f(x) nemutsetse wakachinjika y=k. y-m-63-09.title: Kana i local maximum, i maximum pa interval here?
y-m-63-09.topic: Local extrema ne maximum pa closed interval
y-m-63-09.goal: Ronga kuti local maximum inoenzana ne maximum pa closed interval rini uye kuti haienzani rini, gadzira iwe pachako ma intervals apo chirevo chinoputsika, uye urongedze kuti chii chinofanira kuenzaniswa kuwana maximum.
y-m-63-09.material:
Funga function f(x)=x³−3x. (Verenga 'x cubed minus 3x'.) Derivative i f′(x)=3(x+1)(x−1). Pazasi pane mitengo pa ma integers x.
x | −2 | −1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
f(x) | −2 | 2 | 0 | −2 | 2 | 18
Minji akati, 'Kana pane poinzi mukati me closed interval iri local maximum, saka mutengo we local maximum iwoyo ndiyo maximum ye f pa interval iyoyo.'
y-m-63-09.thinking.1: Gadzira ma intervals anoshanda se counterexamples zvichienderana nemamiriro
y-m-63-09.thinking.2: Ronga ma candidates e maximum pasina kusiya

y-m-63-09.s.s1.prompt: Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama pamusoro pe maximum ye f pa closed interval [−2, 2]?
y-m-63-09.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora x apo f′(x)=0 nemitengo ye f kumativi ese maviri e interval.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.hint.1: Wana mutengo mukuru zvikuru pamitengo yawakanyora, uye uwane ma x ese anopa mutengo uyu.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.a: Maximum i 2, uye inotorwa pa x=−1 chete, apo pane local maximum.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakatarisa local maximum chete uye hakuna kuenzanisa nemitengo iri kumativi e interval.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaverenga kukosha kudiki zvikuru semukuru zvisirizvo kana kwakatarisa local minimum chete.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.c: Maximum i2, uye inotorwa pa x=−1 ne x=2.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaunganidza ndokuenzanisa mapoinzi ari malocal extrema nekukosha pamigumo yechiyero.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.o.d: Hapana maximum. Local maximum haigoni kuva maximum yechiyero.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kwakashaya nyaya umo local maximum inogona kuenzana nemaximum yechiyero. Ienzanise nekukosha pamigumo yechiyero ichi.
y-m-63-09.s.s1.explain: Pane local maximum pa x=−1 ne f(−1)=2, uye pamigumo f(−2)=−2 ne f(2)=2. Saka maximum i2, inotorwa pa x=−1 ne x=2. Pachiyero ichi, chirevo chaMinji chinoita sechinoshanda.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.prompt: Takafarira chiyero kuita [−2, 3], uye f(3)=18. Chii chinoitika kuchirevo chaMinji?
y-m-63-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kana chiyero chiri [−2, 3], ongorora kana poinzi iri local maximum ichiri mukati mechiyero.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.hint.1: Isa kukosha kwelocal maximum nekukosha pamugumo mutsva padivi nedivi uye uenzanise kuti kupi kukuru.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.a: Hachishande. Kukosha 18 pamugumo x=3 kwakakura kupfuura 2.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakaenzanisa kunyange kukosha pamugumo wakangosanganisirwa sezvo chiyero chakafara.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.b: Chichiri kushanda. Local maximum 2 ichiri muchiyero.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakangoongorora kuti local maximum iri muchiyero uye hakuna kuenzanisa kana pane kukosha kukuru.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.c: Hachishande. Poinzi yaiva local maximum yakapera sezvo chiyero chakachinja.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakashaya kuti local maximum inosarudzwa nechimiro padhuze ne x=−1, saka inoramba kunyange kana migumo yechiyero ichichinja.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.o.d: Kana ukachinja chiyero inova function yakasiyana, saka haugoni kuienzanisa
y-m-63-09.s.s2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakashaya kuti function inoramba yakafanana uye chiyero chiri kutariswa chete ndicho chakachinja.
y-m-63-09.s.s2.explain: Pane local maximum pa x=−1 uye kukosha kwelocal maximum kunoramba kuri 2. Asi pamugumo mutsva x=3, f(3)=18 kukosha kukuru, saka maximum yechiyero ichi haisi local maximum asi 18.
y-m-63-09.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira machiyero akavharwa [p, q] 2 akasiyana umo chirevo chaMinji chisingashande. p ne q maintegers kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9, poinzi x=−1 iri local maximum inofanira kuva mukati mechiyero (p<−1<q), asi maximum yechiyero icho inofanira kuva huru kupfuura local maximum 2.

y-m-63-04.title: Tinogona kutsvaga f(3) kubva pamamiriro aya oga here?
y-m-63-04.topic: Kutara polynomial function netsananguro ye derivative nemamiriro e limit
y-m-63-04.goal: Kubva pamamiriro e limit akapiwa, rongedza zvinogona kuzikanwa nezve function (f(2), f′(2)), uye utonge kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa kuti f(3) itarwe.
y-m-63-04.material:
f ndi polynomial function, uye mamiriro e limit anotevera akapiwa.
Kukosha kwe limit ye f(x)/(x−2) sezvo x ichiswedera ku2 ndi3.
(Izvi zvinoreva kuti kukosha kwe limit ye 'f(x) yakaparadzaniswa ne x minus 2' ndi3.) Ngatitarisei kana kukosha kwe f(3) kungawanikwa.
y-m-63-04.thinking.2: Ratidza nemienzaniso kuti ruzivo harwuna kukwana
y-m-63-04.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti polynomial functions ndema continuous, uye tsananguro ye derivative (limit ye difference quotient)
y-m-63-04.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinogona kutaurwa nezve kukosha kwe f(2) pasi pemamiriro aya?
y-m-63-04.s.s1.hint.0: Edza nenhamba kuti chii chinoitika ku quotient kana numerator ichiswedera nhamba isiri 0 apo denominator ichiswedera ku0.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa kuita nyaya apo numerator inoswedera ku0 nenyaya apo isingaiti, uye uenzanise kuti quotient inofamba sei.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kwakaverenga kukosha kwe limit 3 ye quotient se f(2). 3 ndiyo limit ye quotient ye f(x) yakaparadzaniswa ne x−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.o.b: f(2) inogona kuva nhamba chero ipi.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.b: Uku kufunga kwakasiya kuti kana numerator ichiswedera nhamba isiri 0 apo denominator ichiswedera ku0, quotient inokura isina muganhu.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.c: Uku kufunga kwakafunga kuti numerator inofanira kufamba sei kuti quotient iswedere nhamba yakatarwa apo denominator ichienda ku0.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.o.d: Kukosha kwe f(2) hakugoni kuzikanwa uye f′(2) chete ndiyo inogona kuzikanwa.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.r.d: Uku kufunga kwakatadza kubatanidza numerator f(x)−f(2) ye difference quotient ne f(x) mumamiriro aya.
y-m-63-04.s.s1.explain: Denominator x−2 inoswedera ku0, saka kuti quotient iswedere ku3 numerator f(x) inofanirawo kuswedera ku0. Polynomial function ndi continuous, saka f(2)=0, uye ipapo f(x)/(x−2)=(f(x)−f(2))/(x−2), saka tinogona kuzivawo kuti f′(2)=3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.prompt: Kunze kwe f(2)=0 ne f′(2)=3, ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwaizotara kukosha kwe f(3) seimwe chete? Sarudza zvose zvinokwana.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga ma coefficients mangani anofanira kuwanikwa kune linear, quadratic, ne cubic functions, uye uenzanise nehuwandu hwemamiriro awatove nawo.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, edza kana unogona kugadzira functions mbiri kana kupfuura dzinogutsa mamiriro ose.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakasatarisa kuti kuziva degree chete hakutari ma coefficients e quadratic function seimwe chete.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakashandisa chokwadi chekuti linear function inotarwa zvizere ne f(2)=0 ne slope f′(2)=3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.c: f ndi cubic function uye f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaona kuwedzera kukosha kumwe sekukutara. Cubic function ine ma coefficients mazhinji, saka kukosha kumwe chete kunosiya coefficient imwe.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.d: f ndi cubic function uye f(1)=−3.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaona function sayakatarwa nekuti inongoitika kuenderana nekukosha kwe linear function imwe. Functions dzimwe dzinogona kuva nekukosha kwakafanana.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.o.e: f ndi quadratic function uye f(0)=−2.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.r.e: Uku kutonga kwakawedzera degree nekukosha kumwe kwe function uye kwakaenzanisa huwandu hwema coefficients anofanira kuwanikwa nehuwandu hwemamiriro.
y-m-63-04.s.s2.explain: f(2)=0 ne f′(2)=3 atova mamiriro maviri. Linear function ine ma coefficients maviri, saka inotarwa se f(x)=3(x−2), uye f(3)=3. Kana quadratic function ne f(0)=−2 zvikapiwa pamwe chete, inotarwa se f(x)=(x−2)(x+1), uye f(3)=4. Chokwadi chekuva quadratic oga hachitari f(3)=p+3 (p ndiyo coefficient ye x²), uye kuwedzera kukosha kumwe kune cubic function kunosiya coefficient imwe.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.prompt: Tinoda kuratidza kuti kuwedzera 'f ndi quadratic function' chete hakukwani. Ne f(x)=ax²+bx+c (a, b, c ndema integers, a≠0), gadzira functions 2 dzinogutsa mamiriro ekare (f(2)=0, f′(2)=3) asi dzine f(3) dzakasiyana.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a, uye unyore kuti b ne c dzinotarwa sei zvichitevera kubva pamamiriro maviri.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.hint.1: Gadzira functions mbiri ne a dzakasiyana, wozoverenga f(3) yega yega uye uienzanise.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c1: a ndi integer isiri 0, uye b ne c zvakare ndema integers.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Sezvo iri quadratic, a inofanira kuva integer isiri 0, uye b ne c dzinofanirawo kuva integers.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.ok.c3: f(x)/(x−2) inoswedera ku3 sezvo x ichiswedera ku2.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.fail.c3: f(x)/(x−2) haiswederi ku3 sezvo x ichiswedera ku2. Tarisa kuti quotient inoenzana ne expression ipi kana f(2)=0, uye kukosha kwe expression iyoyo kana ukaisa 2.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.explain: Kana tikanyora f(x)=(x−2)(px+q), saka f′(2)=2p+q=3, saka q=3−2p, uye f(3)=p+3. Kana p ikachinja, f(3) inochinjawo. Semuenzaniso, kana f(x)=x²−x−2, saka f(3)=4, uye kana f(x)=2x²−5x+2, saka f(3)=5.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, nyora kuti functions mbiri dzawakagadzira dzinoratidza sei kuti 'ruzivo rwekuti ndi quadratic oga harutari f(3)'.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mutsara unotarisa kana f(2) ne f′(2) dzakafanana kune functions mbiri dzawakagadzira.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Nyora f(3) yema functions maviri padivi pemumwe uye uenzanise kana dzakafanana.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvokwadi zvose zviviri here: functions mbiri dzinogutsa mamiriro akafanana, uye f(3) yadzo yakasiyana?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakapfuurira here nekuti 'saka ruzivo rwekuwedzera runodiwa'?
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.0: x²−x−2 ne 2x²−5x+2 zvose zvinogutsa f(2)=0 ne f′(2)=3, asi f(3) yadzo yakasiyana, 4 ne5. Saka mamiriro ekuva quadratic oga haatari f(3), uye ruzivo rwakawanda runodiwa.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Quadratic functions mbiri dzinogutsa mamiriro ose akafanana, asi f(3) inobuda semakosha akasiyana. Mhinduro haina kutarwa seimwe pasi pemamiriro akafanana, saka ruzivo urwu harwuna kukwana.
y-m-63-04.s.s3.because.model.2: Kunyange kana a yakasiyana, f(2)=0 ne f'(2)=3 zvinogona kuitwa zvakafanana, uye f(3)=a+3, saka f(3) inosiyana kune a imwe neimwe. Saka f(3) haigoni kuzikanwa kubva paruzivo rwekuti ndi quadratic oga.

y-m-63-05.title: Kusiyanisa kwaHajun, kwakatadza papi?
y-m-63-05.topic: Kusiyanisa polynomial functions: kutarisa kukanganisa mumhinduro inoshandisa product rule
y-m-63-05.goal: Mumhinduro inotsvaga derivative ye function yakapiwa seproduct, tsvaga mutsara une kukanganisa, utsanangure kuti kuva nekukosha kumwe chete papoinzi imwe hakuvimbisi kuti mhinduro yakarurama, uye uinyore zvakare zvakarurama.
y-m-63-05.material:
Hajun akawana derivative f′(x) ye f(x)=(x²+1)(x³−x) sezvizvi. (x² inoverengwa 'x squared' uye x³ inoverengwa 'x cubed'.)
Mitsara ndiyo yekutanga (1), yechipiri (2), yechitatu (3), neyechina (4) kubva kumusoro.
y-m-63-05.thinking.0: Verenga mhinduro mutsara nemutsara uye utarise mitemo
y-m-63-05.thinking.1: Ongorora kana kubvumirana papoinzi imwe kwakakwana seumboo
y-m-63-05.thinking.2: Nyora zvakare kukanganisa zvakarurama uye utaure chikonzero
y-m-63-05.prereq.1: Derivative ye xⁿ nekusiyanisa sums nemusiyano we polynomials
y-m-63-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga mumhinduro yaHajun apo mutemo wakashandiswa zvisina kururama.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nemashoko kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakashandisa mutemo upi.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mutemo wemutsara mumwe nemumwe nemashoko, ushandise mutemo iwoyo kuproduct iri nyore zvikuru senge x·x, uiwedzere uye uisiyanise zvakananga, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro.
y-m-63-05.s.s1.line.0: Rega g(x)=x²+1 ne h(x)=x³−x. Ipapo f(x)=g(x)h(x).
y-m-63-05.s.s1.explain: Mutsara we3 wakashata. Derivative ye product yema functions maviri haisi g′(x)h′(x) asi g′(x)h(x)+g(x)h′(x). Mumuenzaniso unyore x·x, product ye ma derivatives ndi1·1=1, asi derivative ye x² ndi2x. Mitsara 1 ne2 yakarurama, uye mutsara we4 unongoverenga mhedzisiro yemutsara we3 sezvayakaita.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.prompt: Hajun akati, "Ndakawanawo 4 kune f′(1) kana ndakasiyanisa expression x⁵−x, yandakawana nekuwedzera product kutanga. Mhedzisiro yangu yakapawo 4, saka mhinduro yangu yakarurama!" Kutonga kwakakodzera kwechirevo ichi ndekupi?
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza imwe kukosha kunze kwe x=1, uye uverenge mhedzisiro yaHajun nemhedzisiro yekusiyanisa mushure mekuwedzera kune iyoyo.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti kana ma expressions maviri akafanana, anofanira kufanana pa x ipi neipi.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.a: x=1 inhamba diki, saka hairi bvunzo chaiyo. Unofanira kuenzanisa panhamba hombe senge 100.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.a: Uku kutonga kwakaona saizi yepoinzi yakaedzwa sedambudziko. Chinokosha kutarisa pamapoinzi akasiyana.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.b: Kuva nekukosha kumwe chete papoinzi imwe kunogona kuva kuenderana. Unofanira kutarisawo pa x dzimwe.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.b: Uku kutonga hakuite mhedziso kubva pakubvumirana papoinzi imwe uye kunoedza kusarudza mapoinzi akawanda ekuedza.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.c: Yakarurama. Nzira mbiri dzose dzakapa kukosha kumwe chete, saka mhinduro yakarurama zvakare.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaona kuva nekukosha kumwe chete papoinzi imwe seumboo hwekuti ma expressions akafanana.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.o.d: Yakashata. Haana kushandisa product rule, saka makosha haagoni kuva akafanana.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakasanganisa nzira kuva yakashata nemakosha kuva akafanana papoinzi imwe. Nzira yakashata inogonawo kupa kukosha kwakafanana nekuenderana.
y-m-63-05.s.s2.explain: Pa x=1, zvose zviviri zvinongoitika kuva 4. Pa x=2, expression yaHajun inopa 6·8−4=44 uye expression 5x⁴−1 yekusiyanisa mushure mekuwedzera inopa 79, saka dzinosiyana. Kubvumirana papoinzi imwe hakusi umboo hwekuti ma expressions akafanana.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare mutsara we3 waHajun zvakarurama kuti uwane f′(x) yakarurama, uye utaurire Hajun mumutsara mumwe kuti chii chakanga chakashata.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga derivative ye expression yakawanikwa nekuwedzera product.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora iwe pachako chimiro che product rule, wozoenzanisa kana mhedzisiro yenzira mbiri yakafanana.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa here f′(x) yawakanyora ne expression yaHajun pa x=2 uye wakatarisa kuti dzinosiyana?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura chikonzero chekuti yakashata nekuti mutemo upi wakarurama, kwete 'mutemo wakasiyana' chete here?
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.0: Nemutemo we product, f′(x)=g′h+gh′=2x(x³−x)+(x²+1)(3x²−1)=5x⁴−1. Unofanira kushandisa product rule, kwete kuwedzera ma derivatives.
y-m-63-05.s.s3.model.1: Kana ukawedzera kutanga, f(x)=x⁵−x, saka f′(x)=5x⁴−1. Hajun akangowedzera ma derivatives akaparadzana, asi derivative ye product haishande nenzira iyoyo.

y-m-63-07.title: Pane tangent line imwe chete inopfuura poinzi P here?
y-m-63-07.topic: Equation ye tangent line: ma tangent lines akadhirowa kubva papoinzi iri kunze kwe curve
y-m-63-07.goal: Mumaitiro ekuwana ma tangent lines akadhirowa kubva papoinzi isiri pa curve, siyanisa poinzi yekubata nepoinzi inopfuurwa nemutsetse, uye usimbise zvakananga kuti pangava nema tangent lines akati wandei anogoneka.
y-m-63-07.material:
Pane curve y=x² nepoinzi P(1, −3). (Verenga 'y i x squared'.) Kana x=1, mutengo we y we curve i 1, saka poinzi P haisi poinzi pa curve. Nara akagadzirisa seizvi.
"Kana f(x)=x², saka f′(x)=2x uye f′(1)=2. Saka tangent line inopfuura poinzi P(1, −3) ine slope 2 i y−(−3)=2(x−1), ndiko kuti, y=2x−5."
Tangent line i mutsetse unopfuura poinzi pa curve (poinzi yekubata) uye une derivative pa poinzi iyoyo seslope yawo.
y-m-63-07.thinking.1: Tora poinzi yekubata sechisinazvozvizivikanwi uye ugutse miganhu
y-m-63-07.thinking.2: Fungisisa nezve huwandu hwema tangent lines zvichienderana nenzvimbo yepoinzi
y-m-63-07.prereq.1: Zvinoreva geometric ye derivative (slope ye tangent line) ne derivative ye quadratic function sa y=x²
y-m-63-07.s.s1.prompt: Dambudziko riri mumhinduro yaNara ndiro rei?
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nema equations kana mutsetse wakawanikwa naNara ne curve zvichisangana chaizvo papoinzi.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti slope 2 i mutengo pa poinzi ipi ye curve, nema coordinates epoinzi P.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.a: Pakanga paine kukanganisa kwekuverenga pakuwana f′(x)=2x, uye kuisa pa x=1 kwakaipawo.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.a: Kuverenga derivative kwakarurama. Kutonga uku hakuna kuongorora kuti mutengo 2 i slope pa poinzi ipi.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.b: Slope 2 i mutengo pa poinzi (1, 1) pa curve, asi P haisi poinzi yekubata.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.b: Uku i kutonga kwakasiyanisa slope pa poinzi yekubata nepoinzi inopfuurwa nemutsetse.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.c: Kunyora equation yemutsetse se y−y₁=m(x−x₁) hakugone kushandiswa kuma tangent lines.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.c: Iyi i pfungwa yakaona chimiro che equation yemutsetse sedambudziko. Chimiro che equation chakarurama, uye dambudziko i zvinoreva zvemitengo yakaiswa.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.o.d: Haugone kudhirowa tangent line kubva papoinzi ine ma coordinates anosanganisira nhamba negative.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i pfungwa yakaona simbi yema coordinates sesarudza kana tangent line ichivapo.
y-m-63-07.s.s1.explain: f′(1)=2 i slope pa poinzi (1, 1) pa curve. Poinzi P haisi pa curve, saka haisi poinzi yekubata. Chaizvo, kugadzirisa y=2x−5 ne y=x² pamwe chete kunopa x²−2x+5=0, ine hapana real roots, saka mutsetse uyu haubate nekunyange curve.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.prompt: Wana ma tangent lines ese e y=x² anopfuura poinzi P(1, −3). Isa mapeya 2 akasiyana e x-coordinate t yepoinzi yekubata ne slope m ye tangent line iyoyo.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ngatitii poinzi yekubata i (t, t²), uye utaure equation ye tangent line pa poinzi iyoyo nema t.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.hint.1: Isa x=1, y=−3 mumutsetse uyu kugadzira equation iyo t inofanira kugutsa, uye uedze mitengo ye t.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.ok.c1: m inoenzana ne derivative pa poinzi yekubata (t, t²).
y-m-63-07.s.s2.fail.c1: m inosiyana ne derivative ye curve pa x-coordinate t yepoinzi yekubata. Isa t mu derivative ye y=x².
y-m-63-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Tangent line iyoyo inopfuura poinzi P(1, −3).
y-m-63-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana poinzi yekubata i (t, t²), tangent line iyoyo haipfuure poinzi P(1, −3). Tarisa kana mutengo we equation ye tangent line pa x=1 i −3.
y-m-63-07.s.s2.explain: Kana poinzi yekubata i (t, t²), tangent line i y=2t(x−t)+t²=2tx−t². Kuti ipfuure P(1, −3), −3=2t−t², ndiko kuti, t²−2t−3=0, saka t=3 kana t=−1. Pane ma tangent lines maviri, y=6x−9 ne y=−2x−1.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.prompt: Kune curve y=x², ndeipi inoenzanisa zvakarurama huwandu hwema tangent lines anogona kudhirowa kuenda ku curve kubva kumapoinzi matatu Q₁(1, 1), Q₂(1, −3), ne Q₃(1, 2)?
y-m-63-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nema y₀ equation iyo poinzi yekubata t ye tangent line inopfuura poinzi (1, y₀) inofanira kugutsa.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa simbi ye discriminant ye equation iyoyo, yakapatsanurwa nehukuru hwe y₀.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.a: Q₁ ine 1, Q₂ ine 2, Q₃ ine 0.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakafungidzira huwandu hwema roots e equation yekubata kana poinzi iri pa curve, pasi payo, nepamusoro payo.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.b: Q₁ ine 2, Q₂ ine 1, Q₃ ine 0.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.b: Iyi i pfungwa yakaona ma tangent lines maviri achibuda kunyange kubva papoinzi iri pa curve. Tarisa chokwadi chekuti poinzi yekubata i poinzi iyoyo pachayo.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.c: Q₁ ine 1, Q₂ ine 0, Q₃ ine 2.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.c: Iyi i pfungwa yakashandurana mabasa edivi repasi nedivi repamusoro re curve. Dhirowa kuti parabola inovhurika kumusoro.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.o.d: Mapoinzi ese matatu ane ma tangent lines 2.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.r.d: Iyi i pfungwa yakaona kuti pane ma tangent lines maviri nguva dzose pasinei nenzvimbo yepoinzi.
y-m-63-07.s.s3.explain: Poinzi yekubata ye tangent line yakadhirowa kubva papoinzi (1, y₀) inogutsa y₀=2t−t², ndiko kuti, t²−2t+y₀=0. Discriminant 4−4y₀ i positive kana y₀<1 (ma tangent lines 2), 0 kana y₀=1 (1), uye negative kana y₀>1 (0). Q₁ ine 1, Q₂ ine 2, uye Q₃ ine 0.

Tarisa ma functions maviri f(x)=|x−1| (absolute value) ne g(x)=(x−1)² pa x=1. Jihye akati, 'Kana function i continuous pa x=1, saka function iyoyo i differentiable pa x=1.'
